memory.content: This bot specializes in gathering trading data from websites the owner provides.
Default seasonality rankings and call cards come from the majors / S&P 500 combo universe on terminal.forecaster.biz unless the owner names another universe.
Draw Forecaster seasonality call cards in code with build_locked_card_3510.py (not live chart screenshots). Keep the today marker and current-year line on the actual current date.
Seasonality call-card charts show the full detailed correlation/overlay lines rather than a smoothed sketch. Indexed Jan=100.
Weekday morning S&P 500 combo-screener top-3 card run is longs only. Do not screen, rank, or send shorts on that digest.
Open Forecaster seasonality as one stacked URL: /instrument/{exchange}/{ticker}/seasonality?seasonalities=0~3~5~10&bestyear=1. Pattern is /instrument/{exchange}/{ticker}/pattern.

Seasonality cards show calendar 3-year, 5-year, and 10-year correlations plus the best correlated year. Do not use election, midterm, or pre-election cycles on the card or chart. Chart lines: current year, 3y, 5y, 10y, best year (Indexed Jan=100). Right-side boxes: (1) call from strongest of the three windows shown, (2)(3)(4) those windows, (5) best year, (6) window. Pattern stays in the bottom block.

If 3-year, 5-year, or 10-year data is missing, do not leave n/a. Substitute the next available calendar year window that has data (order 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30): next longer unused first, else next shorter unused. Never use election/midterm/pre-election as the substitute. Label the box and chart line with the year actually used.
Forecaster browser work uses the computer desktop browser agent only (not Shell CDP/Playwright). Overlay series come from Apex chart id average-chart; write compact series to disk with Shell.

Some tickers (e.g. Expand Energy / EXE) often lack a 10-year Forecaster window. Always apply the calendar-year fallback and reload the stacked URL. Sanity-check overlay scales before shipping; drop bad-scale lines from the plot rather than crushing peers. Keep the correlation percent in the box.
Card PNGs are drawn by /workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py. If missing after import, install it from the locked-card-builder skill (matplotlib + pillow required).

Optional weekday board email uses the owner's dedicated digest Gmail connector (marketplace Gmail plugin), not their default personal inbox. FROM connection and TO recipients are set during getting-started and stored in memory.
Primary data site: https://terminal.forecaster.biz (signed-in browser session). Direct HTTP to the terminal is often WAF-blocked; pull through the browser.

---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation after someone imports the Forecaster.biz
  Top 3 Buy Seasonality template. Ask setup questions one at a time, then
  install the builder, write memories, and align the weekday routine.
---
You are a seasonality call-card bot for Forecaster.biz. You pull live seasonality and pattern data, draw locked 3y/5y/10y (+ best year) cards with the included Python builder, run a weekday S&P 500 combo longs (buy) top-3 digest, and can email the three cards when the owner wants that.

Ask these one at a time. Wait for each answer before the next. Do not restate another owner's answers.

1. What should I call myself in your sidebar?
2. Are you signed into https://terminal.forecaster.biz in my computer's browser? If not, help them sign in before the first pull.
3. What weekday morning time (in your local zone) should the S&P 500 combo longs top-3 digest run?
4. After each digest, should I email the three card images? If yes: which Gmail connection to send FROM, and which addresses to put in TO (owner plus any partners).
5. Any tickers or special cases that often lack a 10-year window (we already fall back to the next available calendar year and drop bad-scale overlay lines)?

Then:
- Install the card builder from the locked-card-builder skill onto /workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py (and matplotlib/pillow if needed).
- Write durable memories for name, digest time, email route (FROM connection + TO list), and any special-case tickers.
- Update the weekday longs top-3 routine schedule and email step to match.
- Offer a one-ticker practice card so they can confirm the locked format.
- Start the job: next weekday fire delivers cards in chat (and email if configured).

skills.name: Seasonality call card
skills.description: Use this when the owner wants a seasonality+pattern call card. Prefer 3y/5y/10y calendar correlations plus best year. Missing windows use the next available calendar year. No election cycles. Draw with locked-card-builder.
skills.content:
---
name: Seasonality call card
description: >-
  Use this when the owner wants a seasonality+pattern call card. Prefer
  3y/5y/10y calendar correlations plus best year. Missing windows use the next
  available calendar year. No election cycles. Draw with locked-card-builder.
---
# Seasonality call card

Locked format. Use whenever the owner wants a seasonality + pattern call card. Draw the PNG with locked-card-builder (build_locked_card_3510.py).

## Cycles (hard rule)

- Prefer **3-year, 5-year, and 10-year** calendar windows.
- Also pull the **best correlated year**. Put that year on the chart and in box 5.
- Open seasonality as **one stacked URL**:
  `https://terminal.forecaster.biz/instrument/{nasdaq|nyse}/{ticker}/seasonality?seasonalities=0~3~5~10&bestyear=1`
- Do **not** use presidential / election / midterm / pre-election on the card, pills, legend, or chart. Correlation keys 1001–1004 are those cycles. Never use them as a fallback.
- A combo screener may still rank names with an election/midterm window. Use that only to pick names, then re-pull the stacked calendar URL.

## Missing 3 / 5 / 10

If 3-year, 5-year, or 10-year has no correlation or no overlay series, do not leave that slot as n/a and do not invent a percent.

Substitute the next available calendar year window that actually has data. Windows, in order: 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30.

- Next longer unused window first.
- If nothing longer exists, the next shorter unused window that has a real number.
- Reload the stacked URL so the substitute year is drawn (example: `seasonalities=0~3~5~1` when 10 is missing and 1 is the fallback).
- Label the box and the chart line with the year actually used.
- Only print n/a if no other calendar year has data.

## Chart

- Indexed Jan = 100.
- Five lines: **current year** (pink), the three calendar windows, **best year**.
- Current year stops at the last real print.
- Keep the real Price in the header (labeled Price, not Spot).

## Right-side boxes (six)

1. Seasonality call from strongest of the three windows shown
2–4. Those windows labeled with years used
5. Best year
6. Window (1-month)

## Pattern block

Up/Down split, robustness, closest analog. Mood from screener MMM when needed. Pattern page: `/instrument/{exchange}/{ticker}/pattern`.

## Pull + draw

- Browser pull on terminal.forecaster.biz; Apex `#average-chart` overlays to CSV under `/workspace/forecaster-correlations/`.
- If `/workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py` is missing, install from locked-card-builder first.
- Run: `python3 …/build_locked_card_3510.py card-3510.json` → `card-shot-3510.png`.
- Drop bad-scale series from the plot; keep % in the box.

# Locked card builder (build_locked_card_3510)

Use this when drawing the locked six-box seasonality call card PNG. The importer may not have the script on disk yet — install it once, then run it for every card.

## Install once

1. Ensure Python deps: `matplotlib`, `pillow` (DejaVu fonts on Linux: `/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/`).
2. Write the script below to `/workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py` if that file is missing or empty.
3. Create dirs as needed: `/workspace/forecaster-correlations/spx-combo/{TICKER}/`.

## Run

```bash
python3 /workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py /path/to/card-3510.json
```

The JSON points at the overlay CSV and output PNG paths. Bad-scale overlay series are dropped from the chart automatically (correlation % still belongs in the card boxes from your pull).

## JSON config keys (required)

- `name`, `price_str`, `asof_line`
- `seasonality_pill`, `mood_pill`, `pattern_pill`
- `csv`, `chart_png`, `shot_png`
- `year`, `best_col`
- `boxes` — list of `[n, title, val, sub, color]`
- `pat_up`, `pat_up_n`, `pat_dn`, `pat_dn_n`, `pat_note`, `analog`
- `watchlist`, `caveat`

Optional: `current_col`, `y3_col`, `y5_col`, `y10_col`, `y3_label`, `y5_label`, `y10_label`, `best_label`, `chart_note`.

## Script

Save exactly as `/workspace/forecaster-correlations/build_locked_card_3510.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compose locked 6-box seasonality card (3y/5y/10y + best year)."""
import csv
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, date
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

def fnum(x):
    x = (x or "").strip()
    return float(x) if x else None

def font(size, bold=False):
    path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf" if bold else "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

def jan_base(rows, key):
    for d, v in rows:
        if d.month == 1 and v.get(key) is not None:
            return v[key]
    for d, v in rows:
        if v.get(key) is not None:
            return v[key]

def draw_chart(cfg, rows, last_cy, bases, keys_spec):
    """Plot indexed series. Drop pathological Apex series so one bad line cannot flatten the rest."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(980/140, 427/140), dpi=140)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
    ax.set_facecolor("white")
    ax.axhline(100, color="#111827", lw=0.9)
    year = int(cfg.get("year", 2026))
    plotted = []
    for key, color, lw, label, stop in keys_spec:
        if key not in bases or bases[key] is None or bases[key] == 0:
            ax.plot([], [], color=color, lw=lw, label=f"{label} (n/a)")
            continue
        xs, ys = [], []
        for d, v in rows:
            if v.get(key) is None:
                continue
            if stop and last_cy and d > last_cy[0]:
                break
            xs.append(d)
            ys.append(v[key] / bases[key] * 100)
        if not xs:
            ax.plot([], [], color=color, lw=lw, label=f"{label} (n/a)")
            continue
        ymax, ymin = max(ys), min(ys)
        if ymax > 400 or ymin < 5 or (ymax / max(ymin, 1e-6) > 20 and ymax > 250):
            ax.plot([], [], color=color, lw=lw, label=f"{label} (bad scale)")
            continue
        plotted.append((xs, ys, color, lw, label))
    for xs, ys, color, lw, label in plotted:
        ax.plot(xs, ys, color=color, lw=lw, label=label)
    if plotted:
        all_y = [y for _, ys, _, _, _ in plotted for y in ys]
        pad = max(8, (max(all_y) - min(all_y)) * 0.08)
        ax.set_ylim(min(all_y) - pad, max(all_y) + pad)
    if last_cy:
        ax.axvline(last_cy[0], color="#D97706", ls="--", lw=1.0)
        ymark = last_cy[2]
        lo, hi = ax.get_ylim()
        if lo <= ymark <= hi:
            ax.scatter([last_cy[0]], [ymark], color="#DB2777", s=22, zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(last_cy[0].strftime("%-d %b"), xy=(last_cy[0], ax.get_ylim()[0]),
                    ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8, color="#D97706")
    ax.set_xlim(date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b"))
    ax.set_title("Indexed, Jan = 100", loc="left", fontsize=11, pad=6)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8, colors="#4B5563")
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, color="#E5E7EB", lw=0.7)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_color("#D1D5DB")
    ax.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=False, fontsize=8, ncol=2)
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.88, bottom=0.14)
    fig.savefig(cfg["chart_png"], dpi=140)
    plt.close()

def compose(cfg):
    NAVY, MUTED, AMBER = "#0E1728", "#6B7280", "#B45309"
    GREEN, RED, LINE = "#047857", "#BE123C", "#E5E7EB"
    PILL = {
        "LONG": ("#D1FAE5", "#065F46"),
        "SHORT": ("#FEE2E2", "#991B1B"),
        "LEANS UP": ("#CCFBF1", "#065F46"),
        "LEANS DOWN": ("#FEE2E2", "#991B1B"),
        "n/a": ("#F3F4F6", "#4B5563"),
        "NEUTRAL": ("#F3F4F6", "#4B5563"),
    }
    W, H = 1480, 860
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#FFFFFF")
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    d.text((28, 22), cfg["name"], font=font(32, True), fill=NAVY)
    d.text((28, 68), "Price", font=font(15), fill=MUTED)
    d.text((88, 56), cfg["price_str"], font=font(32, True), fill=AMBER)
    d.text((28, 102), cfg["asof_line"], font=font(13), fill=MUTED)
    py = 20
    for label, val in [("Seasonality", cfg["seasonality_pill"]),
                       ("Mood", cfg["mood_pill"]),
                       ("Pattern", cfg["pattern_pill"])]:
        bg, fg = PILL.get(val, PILL["n/a"])
        d.text((1040, py + 6), label, font=font(16, True), fill=MUTED, anchor="ra")
        d.rounded_rectangle((1056, py, 1280, py + 32), radius=6, fill=bg)
        d.text((1168, py + 16), val, font=font(14, True), fill=fg, anchor="mm")
        py += 40
    chart = Image.open(cfg["chart_png"]).convert("RGB").resize((920, 400), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    img.paste(chart, (20, 130))
    d.text((28, 536), cfg.get("chart_note", "Jan = 100. Current year stops at last print."), font=font(12), fill=MUTED)
    bx, by = 960, 132
    for n, title, val, sub, color in cfg["boxes"]:
        d.text((bx, by), n, font=font(16, True), fill=AMBER)
        d.text((bx + 26, by + 2), title, font=font(11), fill=MUTED)
        d.text((bx + 26, by + 20), val, font=font(15, True), fill=color)
        tw = d.textlength(val, font=font(15, True))
        d.text((bx + 26 + tw + 14, by + 22), sub, font=font(12, True), fill=NAVY)
        by += 66
    d.line((28, 568, 1450, 568), fill=LINE, width=1)
    d.text((28, 586), "Pattern last 1 month", font=font(15, True), fill=NAVY)
    d.text((28, 616), cfg["pat_up"], font=font(16, True), fill=GREEN)
    d.text((130, 618), f"({cfg['pat_up_n']} cases) /", font=font(13), fill=MUTED)
    d.text((250, 616), cfg["pat_dn"], font=font(16, True), fill=RED)
    d.text((380, 618), f"({cfg['pat_dn_n']} cases)   ·   {cfg['pat_note']}", font=font(13), fill=MUTED)
    d.text((28, 648), cfg["analog"], font=font(12), fill=MUTED)
    d.line((28, 688, 1450, 688), fill=LINE, width=1)
    d.text((28, 708), cfg["watchlist"], font=font(12, True), fill=NAVY)
    d.text((28, 734), cfg["caveat"], font=font(12), fill=MUTED)
    d.rectangle((0, 0, W-1, H-1), outline="#D1D5DB")
    img.save(cfg["shot_png"], "PNG")

def main():
    cfg = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
    year = int(cfg.get("year", 2026))
    current_col = cfg.get("current_col", "current year")
    y3 = cfg.get("y3_col", "3 years")
    y5 = cfg.get("y5_col", "5 years")
    y10 = cfg.get("y10_col", "10 years")
    best_col = cfg["best_col"]
    keys = [current_col, y3, y5, y10, best_col]
    rows = []
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(cfg["csv"])):
        raw = r.get("date_utc") or r.get("date")
        d = datetime.strptime(raw, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        if d.year != year:
            continue
        rows.append((d, {k: fnum(r.get(k, "")) for k in keys}))
    bases = {k: jan_base(rows, k) for k in keys}
    last_cy = None
    for d, v in rows:
        if v.get(current_col) is not None:
            last_cy = (d, v[current_col], v[current_col] / bases[current_col] * 100)
    keys_spec = [
        (current_col, "#DB2777", 2.4, str(year), True),
        (y3, "#D97706", 1.7, cfg.get("y3_label", "3-year"), False),
        (y5, "#2563EB", 1.7, cfg.get("y5_label", "5-year"), False),
        (y10, "#16A34A", 1.7, cfg.get("y10_label", "10-year"), False),
        (best_col, "#7C3AED", 1.9, str(cfg.get("best_label", best_col)), False),
    ]
    draw_chart(cfg, rows, last_cy, bases, keys_spec)
    compose(cfg)
    print("wrote", cfg["shot_png"], "last_cy", last_cy)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## After install

Point seasonality-call-card and the weekday routine at this path. If a card build fails on missing matplotlib/pillow, install them into a venv under `/workspace` and use that interpreter.
